title.zh: Force Bridge 跨链锁（bridge lockscript）约束

subtitle.zh: 来源：nervosnetwork/force-bridge@f3d7df7 ckb-contracts/lib/bridge-lockscript-lib/src/lib.rs + adapter.rs　·　mainnet 0x93bc…1789 / testnet 0x2170…b50e，hash_type type（force-bridge 官方配置）
subtitle.en: Source: nervosnetwork/force-bridge@f3d7df7 ckb-contracts/lib/bridge-lockscript-lib/src/lib.rs + adapter.rs　·　mainnet 0x93bc…1789 / testnet 0x2170…b50e, hash_type type (force-bridge official config)

title.zh: 解锁：由 owner cell 的 lock（委员会多签）授权
title.en: Unlock: authorised by the owner cell lock (committee multisig)

body.zh: Cell{ lock: {{hash = owner cell 的 lock hash}} }
body.en: Cell{ lock: {{hash = owner cell lock hash}} }

body.zh: 本 lock 不检查 outputs
body.en: this lock does not check outputs

role.zh: owner cell 的 type script hash
role.en: type script hash of the owner cell

cons.zh: 必须在 cell_deps 里找到

role.zh: 来源链（链下 ChainType：0 BTC / 1 ETH / 2 EOS / 3 TRON / 4 POLKADOT）
role.en: origin chain (off-chain ChainType: 0 BTC / 1 ETH / 2 EOS / 3 TRON / 4 POLKADOT)

role.zh: 资产标识（如 ETH 代币地址字符串）
role.en: asset id (e.g. ETH token address string)

cond.zh: cell_deps 中存在 type hash = owner_cell_type_hash 的 cell，否则 panic “owner cell not found”
cond.en: a cell_dep with type hash = owner_cell_type_hash exists, else panic "owner cell not found"

cond.zh: 某个 input 的 lock hash = 该 owner cell 的 lock hash，否则 panic “not authorized to unlock the cell”
cond.en: some input lock hash = that owner cell lock hash, else panic "not authorized to unlock the cell"

notes.zh: 所有失败都是 panic，contracts-helper 的 panic_handler 统一 exit(-1)，没有细分错误码。
notes.en: Every failure is a panic; contracts-helper panic_handler exits with -1, so there are no finer error codes.

notes.zh: 不检查签名：安全性完全来自 owner cell 的 lock（官方部署文档：委员会 secp256k1 多签）和 owner cell 的 Type ID 唯一性。
notes.en: No signature is checked here: security comes entirely from the owner cell lock (committee secp256k1 multisig per the official deployment doc) and the Type ID uniqueness of the owner cell.

notes.zh: 注意：CKB Explorer 注册表里名为 “Force Bridge” 的 0x9f3a…f52f 不是这个 bridge lockscript，而是 Force Bridge 部署的未发布版 Omnilock（见 omnilock_v1 页）。
notes.en: Note: the CKB Explorer registry entry named "Force Bridge" (0x9f3a…f52f) is not this bridge lockscript but a pre-release Omnilock deployed by Force Bridge (see the omnilock_v1 page).

notes.zh: 同仓库的 recipient-typescript 不在清单中，未收录。
notes.en: The recipient-typescript in the same repo is not in the list and was not added.
